rule: TinyCLIP 8M/16 ships unless TinyCLIP 39M/16 is ahead on the kind of eye, as the page would decide it, by a paired difference whose 95% interval lies wholly above zero. The measure is the share right on the wildlife test photos (the extra set's vectors were not published for both models).
why: On the share right on the wildlife test photos (the extra set's vectors were not published for both models), TinyCLIP 39M/16 is ahead of TinyCLIP 8M/16 by +5.6 points (+4.7 to +6.6), paired over the same photos. The interval lies above zero, so the larger pocket model ships: a wrong kind gives a person the wrong eyes, and that weighs more than 31 MB downloaded once.
